description: One append-only event on the organization's event ledger. Receipts and audit trails hang off this stream. Immutable: no updates, no deletes.

seq.description: Per-organization sequence number. Gaps are detectable; forks are not allowed.

type.description: Namespaced event type, e.g. receipt.minted, task.state_changed, approval.granted.

title: LedgerEvent
